Pumpkin Bread

  • Makes 1 loaf (12 servings)
  • 1 hour 25 minutes
  • Source
  • Meat

A soft, spiced pumpkin bread loaf you stir together by hand in about 10 minutes, no mixer needed, that stays moist for days

Pumpkin bread

  • 210g all-purpose flour
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • ½ tsp baking powder
  • ½ tsp salt
  • 2 tsp ground cinnamon
  • ¼ tsp grated nutmeg
  • 300g pumpkin puree
  • 250g granulated sugar
  • 160ml vegetable oil
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Preheat the oven to 180°C. Grease a 23x13cm (9x5-inch) loaf pan with baking spray.

In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.

In a medium bowl, combine the pumpkin puree, sugar, oil, eggs, and vanilla and whisk until well combined.

Pour the wet mixture into the dry mixture and stir together until just combined. Pour the batter into the prepared pan.

Bake for 1 hour, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with a few moist crumbs and the center springs back when lightly pressed. Let cool in the pan for 15 minutes, then remove the loaf and cool completely on a wire rack.

If the top is taking on a lot of color, loosely cover the loaf with a sheet of foil after 30 minutes of baking. The thin layer of foil protects the top from browning too much and possibly burning.

Built with NYUM. Enjoy!
